activity_if_known: Ignition of clothing from controlled heat source
narrative: While an employee was grinding a weld, sparks caused his shirt to catch on fire. He received second and third degree burns from the mid torso to the upper chest area.

activity_if_known: Injured by object breaking in hand
narrative: An employee was pulling a glass from the glass rack. The glass hit the counter and broke, severely lacerating the employee's right wrist.

activity_if_known: Struck by running powered equipment  during maintenance, cleaning, testing
narrative: An employee was conducting preventative maintenance on an extrusion press and using an impact wrench to remove rivets on the shear cylinder. When the last rivet was removed, the stored energy in the cylinder released and dropped it onto the employee's hand. Their right thumb was caught between the cylinder and the casing of the rivet gun, resulting in crushing injuries. The employee sustained an amputation of the thumb without bone loss. The machine was locked out/tagged out at the time.

activity_if_known: Bending, crawling, reaching, twisting-single episode
narrative: The employee was bending down in the stock room in order to pick up a piece of a metal clothing rack. She twisted and her leg gave out causing her to fall to the ground and break her tibia at the knee. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

activity_if_known: Ingestion of harmful substance
narrative: An employee drank from an electrolyte solution bottle in the refrigerator that had been filled with degreaser. The employee became sick and was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Injured by handheld object or equipment, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was cutting a steel plate using a grinder equipped with a cut-off wheel. The cut-off wheel jammed in the material causing the grinder to kick back. The employee dropped the grinder. The employee was hit by the spinning cut-off wheel and sustained a laceration to the right shin area.

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening less than 6 feet
narrative: A temporary employee walked across a wooden pallet to retrieve product to stock. When he walked back across the pallet, it broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and sustain a fractured hip.

activity_if_known: Nonroadway collision with object other than vehicle, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when his foot slipped. When he tried to correct himself, his hand came off the steering control and the forklift struck a guardrail. He suffered a foot fracture.

activity_if_known: Struck by running powered equipment  n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was strapping down a mini excavator. While walking down the ramp they slipped and their right foot became caught under the blade of the mini excavator. The blade lowered and crushed their foot, fracturing it.

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 21 to 25 feet
narrative: An employee was fixing low-voltage wires in a store's garden center when he fell 25 feet to the ground, suffering a broken back and brain hemorrhaging.

activity_if_known: Injured by physical contact during horseplay
narrative: Employee 1 fell on employee 2's leg, causing several fractures in employee 2's leg that required hospitalization.

activity_if_known: Fall or jump from and struck by same vehicle in normal operation, nonroadway
narrative: An employee was being trained on how to operate an electric pallet jack. When he stepped off the pallet jack, it continued moving and struck his left foot, lacerating it and breaking his ankle.

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 11 to 15 feet
narrative: An employee was using a cutting torch to disassemble a metal staircase. The stringer became loose, causing the landing to begin shaking, and the employee lost his balance and fell 9 to 12 feet. He suffered injuries to his head and right shoulder.

activity_if_known: Fall to lower level from collapsing structure or equipment  unspecified
narrative: An employee removed a welded lug that was attached to a ramp he was standing on and he fell. The employee sustained a closed head injury, right rib fractures, a right scapula fracture, a right pelvis fracture, and a lung infiltrate injury.

activity_if_known: Fall from pedal cycle
narrative: An employee was riding a bicycle between two buildings on a campus. The bicycle chain disengaged and the employee fell, suffering a broken collarbone, a head laceration, and a scraped knee.

activity_if_known: Overexertion involving outside sources, unspecified
narrative: An employee was moving concrete debris at a job site when they felt pain in their abdomen from a hernia.

activity_if_known: Slip on substance without fall
narrative: An employee was delivering a cylinder of gas to a customer. The cylinder was being moved with a cylinder cart. As the employee was walking the cart and cylinder to the customer's door, he slipped in the snow. His hand got caught between the cylinder and the concrete parking lot. The employee crushed the tips of his index and middle finger on his right hand. In-patient hospitalization was required for surgery on the fingers.

activity_if_known: Stings and venomous bites
narrative: An employee was staying in a dorm room for a six-month training session. The employee was bitten by an insect and hospitalized with left and right arm paralysis.

activity_if_known: Stings and venomous bites
narrative: An employee was bitten on the right index finger by a copperhead snake, resulting in hospitalization and treatment.

activity_if_known: Struck by falling part of vehicle or machine, still attached
narrative: An employee was using a forklift to dump a hopper into a dumpster. The employee used his left hand to pull the lever on the hopper to release the materials into the dumpster while placing his right hand on the forks of the forklift. When the employee pulled the lever, the hopper jolted back and struck the employee's right hand, crushing his fingertips. The employee suffered amputation of the right index and middle fingertips.

activity_if_known: Fall on same level  n.e.c.
narrative: An employee fell to the floor while moving a helium tank. The tank fell onto the employee, who sustained a fractured left wrist, a laceration to the left hand, and an impact injury to the head.

activity_if_known: Caught or wedged between objects  nonrunning
narrative: An employee was reassembling a de-energized piece of equipment after cleaning it. She was pushing the fill hopper back into place on the equipment when her right ring finger became pinched between the hopper and the bump stop guide on the equipment, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

activity_if_known: Injured by handheld object or equipment, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was using a chop saw to cut a granite curb. When he set the saw down, the blade was still rotating and made contact with the curb. The saw then kicked back and struck the employee in the right shoulder and forearm, slicing his skin.

activity_if_known: Ignition of clothing from controlled heat source
narrative: An employee was standing next to a portable electric heater. The lower right leg of the employee's coveralls caught fire due to the presence of a flammable substance on the coveralls and reignited twice during efforts to put it out. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to the lower right leg.

activity_if_known: Exposure through unintentional needlestick or sharp injury
narrative: An employee was removing nitrogen from a system when a tool malfunctioned and a Schrader pin hit the employee's hand and nitrogen gas got under the skin on the employee's left arm and hand.

activity_if_known: Trip from stepping into a hole without fall
narrative: An employee was working in the middle foundry molding area when he stepped in a hole and broke his left ankle.

activity_if_known: Struck by object or equipment dropped by injured worker
narrative: An employee was cleaning a shrimp sear plate when it fell off the cooler. The employee tried to catch it and his hand was crushed under the plate. The employee sustained fractures to four fingers on the right hand.

activity_if_known: Struck by discharged or flying object, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was working in the pallet repair line when a pneumatic nail gun shot a nail into their right wrist. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery to remove the nail.

activity_if_known: Injured by slipping or swinging object held by other person
narrative: A maintenance mechanic was working with another employee to fix the recycle waste conveyor chain. They needed to knock out a bushing on the conveyor chain using a steel rod and bull pin. The employee working with the mechanic struck the metal rod while the mechanic's finger was between the rod and the bull pin. The mechanic's right middle finger was partially amputated.
